name: Brunella

weapons.name: Longbow +2
weapons.note: Enspelled with Ensnaring Strike. Requires attunement. A longbow is a Martial weapon and the Bard is proficient with Simple weapons only, but a DM rule in this campaign grants every elf proficiency with the longbow and the longsword, so the proficiency bonus does apply.

cantrips.name: Vicious Mockery
cantrips.desc:
You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at one creature you can see within range. If the target can hear you (it doesn't need to understand you), it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 2d6 Psychic damage (cantrip scales: 1d6 at L1, 2d6 at L5, 3d6 at L11, 4d6 at L17) and have Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 340

cantrips.name: Minor Illusion
cantrips.desc:
You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.
	If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, it can determine that the effect is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint.
	Sound. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream.
	Image. If you create an image of an object, it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 298

cantrips.name: Message
cantrips.desc:
You point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.
	You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 298

cantrips.name: Prestidigitation
cantrips.desc:
You create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time.
	Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor.
	Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.
	Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot.
	Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour.
	Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour.
	Minor Creation. You create a nonmagical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 307

cantrips.name: Guidance
cantrips.desc:
You touch a willing creature and choose a skill. Until the spell ends, the creature adds 1d4 to any ability check it makes using the chosen skill. The creature can wait until immediately after it rolls the d20 of the ability check before deciding to use the Guidance die, but must decide before the DM says whether the check succeeds or fails.

Granted by the Magic Initiate (Cleric) feat; spellcasting ability: Charisma.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 282

cantrips.name: Sacred Flame
cantrips.desc:
Flame-like radiance descends on a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d8 Radiant damage (cantrip scales: 1d8 at L1, 2d8 at L5, 3d8 at L11, 4d8 at L17). The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this save.

Granted by the Magic Initiate (Cleric) feat; spellcasting ability: Charisma.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 311

spellbook.name: Faerie Fire
spellbook.desc:
Each object in a 20-foot Cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity saving throw. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed Dim Light in a 10-foot radius.
	Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it, and the affected creature or object can't benefit from the Invisible condition.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 270

spellbook.name: Dissonant Whispers
spellbook.desc:
You whisper a discordant melody that only one creature of your choice within range can hear, wracking it with terrible pain. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 Psychic damage and must immediately use its Reaction, if available, to move as far as its Speed allows away from you. The creature moves into the safest available space unless there isn't one, in which case it doesn't move. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.
	Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 265

spellbook.name: Heroism
spellbook.desc:
A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. Until the spell ends, the creature is immune to the Frightened condition and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns.
	Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 285

spellbook.name: Invisibility
spellbook.components: V, S, M (an eyelash in gum arabic)
spellbook.desc:
A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
	Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 289

spellbook.name: Knock
spellbook.desc:
Choose an object that you can see within range and that is closed, such as a door, box, chest, set of manacles, padlock, or other object that contains a mundane or magical means that prevents access.
	A target that is held shut by a mundane lock or that is stuck or barred becomes unlocked, unstuck, or unbarred. If the object has multiple locks, only one of them is unlocked. If you choose a target that is held shut with Arcane Lock, that spell is suppressed for 10 minutes, during which time the target can be opened and shut normally.
	When you cast the spell, a loud knock audible from as far away as 300 feet emanates from the target.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 290

spellbook.name: Lesser Restoration
spellbook.desc:
You touch a creature and end one condition on it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 291

spellbook.name: Dispel Magic
spellbook.desc:
Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.
	Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You automatically end a spell on the target if the spell's level is equal to or less than the level of the slot you use.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 265

spellbook.name: Mass Healing Word
spellbook.desc:
Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on Undead or Constructs.
	Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 3.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 296

spellbook.name: Major Image
spellbook.components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece)
spellbook.desc:
You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot Cube. The image appears at a spot you can see within range and lasts for the duration. It seems real, including sounds, smells, and temperature appropriate to the thing depicted, but it can't deal damage or cause a condition.
	If you are within range of the illusion, you can take a Magic action to cause the image to move to any other spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you can alter the image so that it appears to be walking. Similarly, you can cause the illusion to make different sounds at different times, even making it carry on a conversation.
	Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be illusory, since things can pass through it. A creature that takes the Study action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and any sounds it makes sound hollow to the creature.
	Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The spell lasts until dispelled, without requiring Concentration, if cast with a level 4+ spell slot.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 295

innateSpells.name: Wild Cunning
innateSpells.desc:
You invoke nature spirits for aid, choosing one of the following effects:
	You gain advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track creatures within range for the next hour.
	You locate edible forage within range.
	You find clean drinking water within range.
	You identify suitable shelter within range.
	The spirits construct a campsite within range, complete with a fire, tents, bedrolls and supplies.
	The spirits dismantle a campsite within range, extinguishing the fire, striking the tents, packing everything up and burying the waste.

Granted by the Ritual-Grimoire; cast in ritual mode only (casting time + 10 minutes, no spell slot). A Druid/Ranger spell, off the Bard list entirely.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 36 — Starter Spells (2017). Playtest material, never published in any Player's Handbook.

innateSpells.name: Guiding Hand
innateSpells.desc:
You manifest a tiny luminous hand in an empty space within range. After you name a landmark on the same plane of existence that appears on a historical map, the hand guides you toward it. When you move toward the hand, it retreats 5 feet ahead in the direction of the landmark. If you stay still, it beckons you onward every 1d4 minutes.

Granted by the Ritual-Grimoire; cast in ritual mode only (casting time + 10 minutes, no spell slot). It IS on the Bard list, but it is not in Brunella's spellbook and ritual casting would otherwise require preparing it.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 36 — Starter Spells (2017). Playtest material, never published in any Player's Handbook.

innateSpells.name: Ensnaring Strike
innateSpells.castingTime: Bonus Action, immediately after hitting a creature with a weapon
innateSpells.desc:
As you hit the target, grasping vines appear on it, and it makes a Strength saving throw. A Large or larger creature has Advantage on this save. On a failed save, the target has the Restrained condition until the spell ends. On a successful save, the vines shrivel away, and the spell ends.
	While Restrained, the target takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The target or a creature within reach of it can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. On a success, the spell ends.
	Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

Granted by the Enspelled Longbow +2 and cast by expending 1 of the bow's charges — never a spell slot. It is a Ranger spell and is not on the Bard list.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 268

innateSpells.name: Detect Magic
innateSpells.desc:
For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.
	The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Granted by the High Elf lineage (Elven Lineage); spellcasting ability: Charisma.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 262

innateSpells.name: Misty Step
innateSpells.desc:
Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Granted by the High Elf lineage (Elven Lineage), available from level 5; spellcasting ability: Charisma.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 299

innateSpells.name: Healing Word
innateSpells.desc:
A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains Hit Points equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on Undead or Constructs.
	Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 1.

Granted by the Magic Initiate (Cleric) feat: castable once per long rest without a slot (or with a Bard spell slot); spellcasting ability: Charisma.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 p. 285

resources.name: Wild Cunning
resources.desc: Ritual only: casting time + 10 minutes, no spell slot, unlimited uses. Track, forage, find water or shelter, or have the nature spirits pitch or strike the whole campsite.

resources.name: Guiding Hand
resources.desc: Ritual only: casting time + 10 minutes, no spell slot, unlimited uses. A luminous hand leads you to a named landmark. Takes concentration — up to 8 hours.

resources.name: Longbow +2 — Charges
resources.desc: Enspelled Longbow +2. Expend 1 charge to cast Ensnaring Strike as a Bonus Action immediately after hitting a creature with the bow (item save DC 13). Regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn — a long rest does not refill it. Requires attunement.

resources.name: Bardic Inspiration
resources.desc:
Bonus Action. Choose a creature other than yourself within 60 ft that can hear you; it gains a Bardic Inspiration die (d8 at L5). Within the next hour, once before the die is lost, the creature can roll the die and add it to one D20 Test it makes (it can decide after seeing the d20 roll but before the outcome is known), or use it for a feature that consumes it (e.g. Cutting Words).

Die scales with bard level: d6 (L1) / d8 (L5) / d10 (L10) / d12 (L15).

Uses per rest = Charisma modifier (4).

Font of Inspiration (Bard L5): you regain all expended uses on a Short or Long Rest. In addition, once per turn you can expend a spell slot (no action) to regain one expended use.

Source: Player's Handbook 2024 — Bard L1 / Font of Inspiration L5.

resources.name: Cutting Words
resources.desc:
Reaction (Lore L3): when a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a damage roll or succeeds on a D20 Test, expend one use of Bardic Inspiration, roll the die, and subtract the number rolled from the creature's roll — reducing the damage or potentially turning the success into a failure.

Draws from the Bardic Inspiration pool above.

resources.name: Bonus Proficiencies
resources.desc: Lore L3: you gain proficiency in three skills of your choice (already reflected in this character's skill list: History, Investigation, Performance).

resources.name: Magic Initiate (Cleric)
resources.desc: Origin feat from the Acolyte background. Grants the cleric cantrips Guidance and Sacred Flame, and the level 1 cleric spell Healing Word (castable once per long rest without a slot, or with a Bard spell slot). Spellcasting ability: Charisma. The free Healing Word cast is tracked on the Healing Word spell itself.

notes: High Elf · Bard 5 (College of Lore) · Acolyte background. Spellcasting ability: Charisma (DC 15, attack +7). Saving throw proficiencies: Dexterity, Charisma. High Elf traits: Darkvision 60 ft, Fey Ancestry (Advantage vs. Charmed, immune to magical sleep), Trance (4-hour long rest), Keen Senses (Perception). DM rule (this campaign): every elf is proficient with the longbow and the longsword. Tool proficiency: Calligrapher's Supplies. Jack of All Trades (+1) already baked into initiative (+3).
